findings.evidence: `AlmostComplex/Pullback.lean:163` and `:341` define `eq_pullback_iff` for both single-structure pullbacks. The PR's own check (`pullback_twoSMulDiffeomorph_ofComplexManifold`) relies on it.
findings.fix: Add `theorem eq_pullback_iff {K} : K = J.pullback g hnr ↔ ∀ q v, mfderiv I I' g q.2 (K.tangentEndomorphism q v) = J.tangentEndomorphism (q.1, g q.2) (mfderiv I I' g q.2 v)`. Prove it from `freeze_pullback` and the single-structure `eq_pullback_iff`.
findings.issue: `ContMDiffAlmostComplexStructureFamily.pullback` has no characterising lemma: there is no counterpart of main's `ContMDiffAlmostComplexStructure.eq_pullback_iff`. Users must unfold `ext` and `pullback_tangentEndomorphism_apply` to show that a family equals `g^* J`.

findings.evidence: This follows the pattern of main's `ContMDiffAlmostComplexStructure.eq_pullback_iff`. The PR proves only the forward direction, at line 176 of the inhomogeneous-term file (`mfderiv_tangentHom_pullback_apply`).
findings.fix: Add `eq_pullback_iff : μ = ν.pullback g hnr ↔ ∀ q v, mfderiv I I' g q.2 (μ.val.tangentHom q v) = ν.val.tangentHom (q.1, g q.2) v`, proved by injectivity of `mfderiv` (`g.isInvertible_mfderiv`), and add the matching lemma for `DomainDependentHomSection`.
findings.issue: `InhomogeneousTerm.pullback` (and `DomainDependentHomSection.pullback`) has only the forward intertwining lemma `mfderiv_tangentHom_pullback_apply`. Nothing characterises the pullback as the unique term that `dg` carries to `ν`.

summary: The new family and inhomogeneous-term pullbacks are missing the uniqueness characterisation that main provides for the single-structure pullback (`eq_pullback_iff`). Apart from that, the surface is minimal and the annotations are sound.
